integrity: Proof and standalone exact-integer checker are bundled; finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns surjective words over the Klein-four additive alphabet and n>=4. Odd-length projection norms are proved strictly greater than one without an exact general formula; historical priority is bounded and independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Four-colour surjections: complete Walsh support, sharp gaps and a parity jump in projection contractivity
